relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Two weeks after SNI, light brush produced a robust number of Fos+ Oprm1tdT+ neurons in laminae I-II

key_findings: Spared nerve injury reduced dorsal horn Oprm1 expression and DAMGO responsiveness of Oprm1-expressing interneurons while increasing their excitability (lower rheobase, higher sEPSC frequency) and brush-evoked Fos.
Chemogenetic activation of spinal Oprm1-INs produced mechanical hypersensitivity in naive mice, and their inhibition reduced SNI-induced mechanical and cold hypersensitivity.
